opening.argument: The video promotes Forsage/SAGE as a genuine source of passive income, highlighting earnings of 6.5 BNB and approximately Rs.6,40,000 while presenting that result as otherwise impossible to earn in one month offline. It does more than discuss the program: the title urges viewers to join, and the speaker calls the income “real, Genuine, Authentic and Passive.” Viewers are then directed to contact a person through WhatsApp to learn how to earn it, while being invited to become part of the program and team. Taken together, these statements actively solicit participation through promised investment-related returns, rather than offering detached commentary or education.
